text.content:
"The Cattery": Danger Gal's concrete fortress at the foot of the bridge.

Region: Downtown, City Center, at the foot of the Coronado Bay Bridge (#28)
Controlled by: Danger Gal
The feel of it: Eighteen floors of ex-Whitewater concrete, still pink inside, with a cat café in the lobby
Danger: SC 10: Danger Gal Security, Hardened Heavy

Built in 2051 as Whitewater Security's headquarters and bought by Danger Gal in spring 2070. It sits between NCPD Precincts 1 and 3, with a neon cat's eye on the north face staring at the Arasaka Waterfront.

Inside

  • Roof: an AV pad, two Danger Gal AV-4s and the cat's eye; a snipers' nest in the old Whitewater comms mast.
  • 15–18, the Litter: staff housing for about 150 Kittens. Still pink, and still a maze on purpose.
  • 13–14: Minako's floor and the board room.
  • 11–12: the Puma Squad's suites, training sims, R&R and armory.
  • 6–10: detective floors: case rooms, interview rooms, analysts, and the bridge camera room.
  • 3–5: armory, firing range, and Whitewater's holding cells, kept "for client safety".
  • 1–2: the public lobby and cat café, which takes walk-ins; vehicle bays below the ramp.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05, 07
